item.title: Talking to My Computer: Three Dictation Tools in One Year
item.description: I talk to my computer for a living and for entertainment now. Not in meetings, I mean it literally: most of what I “type” into a terminal, into notes and into the chat window of an LLM, I say out loud. A year ago I typed all of it. This is the story of how I got from one to the other, through three tools, and what it ended up costing.
